properties.title: Flood Advisory issued November 7 at 5:54PM AST until November 7 at 7:30PM AST by NWS San Juan PR
properties.description:
* WHAT...Urban area and small stream flooding caused by excessive
rainfall is expected.

* WHERE...Catano in Puerto Rico...
Dorado in Puerto Rico...
Toa Baja in Puerto Rico...

* WHEN...Until 730 PM AST.

* IMPACTS...Minor flooding in low-lying and poor drainage areas.
Water over roadways.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...
- At 554 PM AST, Doppler radar indicated heavy rain due to
thunderstorms. This  will cause urban and small stream flooding.
Between 1 and 2 inches of rain have fallen.
- Additional rainfall amounts up to 1 inch are expected over the
area. This additional rain will result in minor flooding.
properties.instruction:
Turn around, don't drown when encountering flooded roads. Most flood
deaths occur in vehicles.

Be aware of your surroundings and do not drive on flooded roads.

Please report observed flooding to local emergency services or law
enforcement and request they pass this information to the National
Weather Service when you can do so safely.

properties.title: Flood Warning issued November 7 at 11:01AM EST by NWS Melbourne FL
properties.description:
...The Flood Warning continues for the following rivers in Florida...

St Johns River Near Sanford affecting Seminole County.

.Heavy rainfall has caused river levels on the St. Johns near Sanford
to rise in Action Stage. The river is forecast to climb into Minor
flood stage this weekend with a continued rise through Minor flood
stage anticipated through next week.

For the St. Johns River...including Sanford...Minor flooding is
forecast.

* WHAT...Minor flooding is forecast.

* WHERE...St Johns River near Sanford.

* WHEN...Until further notice.

* IMPACTS...At 6.2 feet, Water completely surrounds many homes in the
Stone Island and Still Brook subdivisions. Pool enclosures and
patios become flooded. Water covers many of the roads. Flooding
occurs on Enterprise Road and in the Bethel Loop subdivision.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...
- At 10:30 AM EST Saturday the stage was 5.3 feet.
- Bankfull stage is 4.2 feet.
- Forecast...The river is expected to rise above flood stage
tomorrow morning and continue rising to 6.2 feet early Wednesday
afternoon. Additional rises are possible thereafter.
- Flood stage is 5.5 feet.
- http://www.weather.gov/safety/flood
properties.instruction:
Motorists should not attempt to drive around barricades or drive cars
through flooded areas.

Caution is urged when walking near riverbanks.

Additional information is available at www.weather.gov.

The next statement will be issued Sunday morning at 1145 AM EST.

properties.description:
* WHAT...Flooding caused by upstream dam releases continues.

* WHERE...Maricopa County in south central Arizona...

* WHEN...Until 200 AM MST Monday.

* IMPACTS...Flooding of rivers, creeks, streams, and other low-lying
and flood-prone locations is occurring. Low-water crossings are
inundated with water and may not be passable.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...
- At 721 AM MST, upstream floodgate release from Tempe Town Lake
and continued releases from Granite Reef Dam farther upstream has
lead to flooding in the warned area. A US Army Corps of Engineers
streamflow gauge on the Gila River showed the flow near Old US 80
was around 1900 cfs. Another automated gauge reported that the
current pool elevation of Painted Rock Lake was around 571 feet.
- Flooding is occurring along the Gila River.
- Some locations that will experience flooding include...
Goodyear, Painted Rock Dam, Liberty, Phoenix International
Raceway and Arlington.
